title: Isla's Day of Pausing

segments.text: Here’s today’s Sapiver Press puzzle comic.
The morning traffic hums outside the window, urging Isla to hurry before the day gets too crowded.
Finding a steady corner, Isla decides to slow her pace down instead of rushing her decisions today.
She forces herself to sit still for a moment, resisting the urge to jump to the next task.
Anti-Knight today — knight moves block matching numbers.
Sipping her lukewarm tea at a tiny corner table, she finally feels the tension leave her shoulders.
Back home, she reminds herself that pausing between errands is a habit worth keeping for the future.
